summary: A Yes vote increases the City of Point Arena's transient occupancy (lodging) tax from 12% to 14%, effective April 1, 2027, with no end date unless repealed.

tax.text: A Yes vote raises the city’s lodging tax from 12% to 14% starting April 1, 2027, generating more general-fund revenue.
tax.quote: Raises the city’s tax on hotel, inn and vacation rental stays from 12% to 14%, starting April 1, 2027.

tax.text: A No vote keeps the city’s lodging tax at 12%.
